content: dinit COMPLETE 47/47: Alpine/Artix model (ship-only -dinit pkgs, rules-driven boot.d enablement, initd-aligned names), new pkgs networking-dinit/incus-feature-dinit/dinit-boot-log, sshd-dinit deleted, logrotate RE-ADDED (vector only tails rotated files: copytruncate+delaycompress), all daemon services log-type=file -> /var/log/dinit/, dinit_log_file=/run/dinit-boot.log cmdline + dinit-chimera r5 wrapper reads it from /proc/cmdline (booster does not forward unknown params), dinitctl --offline crashes on Alpine 0.21 (direct boot.d symlinks instead), harness hard 7m limit + 5m boot + keep-target/verify split, services_status dinit-aware.
